rule: The transactions beats 5 to 7 show. Beat 7 shows strangerBrief's brief, then Maat's agent's reply to it from the published agent-journal branch, then vaultAnswer's verdict. Set hash to the tx hash once it is on Base mainnet and render again; while hash is null the film shows a card labelled PLACEHOLDER, except in beat 7, which shows a stand-in instead (beat7). Before it shows a tx, the render reads its receipt and calldata and stops unless it matches expect: the event, the contract of deployments/README.md that emitted it, the vault's reason, who sent it (sender: for a Decision, /ledger's sender label, agent, probe, brief-driven or owner, by hand; for a Brief, outside or team), the New York date, and for the early-close pair the side of the early close (etBefore: before that New York time; etFrom: at or after it).

beat7.rule: Beat 7, dated Sat 28 Nov 2026 (film/README.md, "Beat 7: the rule"). strangerBrief and vaultAnswer show only when both are set and the intent that adopted the brief was decided on Base by cutoff (Mon 7 Dec 2026 21:00 UTC); set them only for a brief that /proof counts as an outside brief. Until then the beat shows its first stand-in whose txs are all set: teamBrief and teamAnswer, a team wallet brief and the vault's verdict on the intent that adopted it, labelled team brief and never counted as a user; otherwise agentAllowedGoogl and agentAllowedAapl, two of Maat's agent's own intents of Fri 27 Nov, both allowed, under a caption with /proof's live counts. A placeholder never shows.
